description: Ferozsons Laboratories Limited was established in 1954 as one of Pakistan's first pharmaceutical manufacturers and is now in its seventh decade. It imports, manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products and medical devices, with leading brands in gastroenterology, hepatology, cardiology and oncology, and sells into a growing number of export markets.
